channel.title: The Grant Desk - added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: added in last 30 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: ANAT: Synapse Residency Program 2027 (Australia)
item.description: Australian Network for Art and Technology (ANAT) · deadline 14 Oct 2026 · Total artist fee of AUD 19,250 ex GST plus 12% superannuation, plus up to AUD 3,500 toward other project expenses. No application fee.

item.title: Ernest Albert Invitational 2027: Reflective Residency at Cas-co x Kunsthal Mechelen
item.description: Cas-co, Leuven and Kunsthal Mechelen · deadline 14 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,480 total including VAT: an artist fee of EUR 1,100 per month, a transportation allowance of EUR 120 per month, and a one-time production budget of EUR 600. No application fee.

item.title: LOEWE FOUNDATION: Craft Prize 2027
item.description: LOEWE FOUNDATION · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 50,000 for the winning entry. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Fellowship for Utopian Practice 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, feedback and mentoring. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Black Utopian Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Disability Arts + Dreaming Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, a Thought Partner, mentors in the field, and access check-ins, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Climate Justice Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.

item.title: Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles: Bourses et aides aux projets en Arts numeriques (15 October 2026 session)
item.description: Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles, Service de la Creation artistique (Direction des Arts visuels) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Bourses (creation or research, individuals only): EUR 1,000 to 15,000. Aides au projet (conception, production, promotion, diffusion): EUR 1,000 to 50,000. No application fee.

item.title: Hessische Kulturstiftung: Reise- und Residenzstipendien 2027/2028 (18th round)
item.description: Hessische Kulturstiftung · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Travel grants of EUR 25,000 (3 to 12 months), plus access to up to EUR 7,700 additional production funding after the grant. 14 grants over two years: 5 travel, 7 residency (NYC, London, Paris, Istanbul, Kyoto), 2 combined. NOTE: figures are from the call text as republished verbatim by listing sites; the official funding-guidelines PDF was unavailable at the time of adding, so verify on hkst.de. No application fee.

item.title: Pedantic Arts Residency and Research Grant 2027 (Pittsburgh)
item.description: Pedantic Arts Residency · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Residency: free furnished housing in a shared apartment plus a USD 2,000 living stipend (half on arrival, half on completion). Research Grant: a free private bedroom at the Pedantic Apartment plus a USD 500 or USD 1,000 honorarium at the grantee's discretion. Application free until 28 September 2026, then USD 20.

item.title: Tilting Axis Fellowship 2027 for Caribbean-Based Practitioners (with Nieuwe Instituut)
item.description: Tilting Axis, with Nieuwe Instituut, Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, Fresh Milk (Barbados), RAA! (Aruba) and Instituto Buena Bista (Curacao) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,500 stipend per fellow, plus up to EUR 1,000 travel budget for research-related movement and full coverage of airfare and Netherlands programming during the visit. No application fee.

item.title: Nordic Culture Fund: ENTER 2026 (exploratory cross-border collaboration)
item.description: Nordic Culture Fund · deadline 16 Oct 2026 · Up to DKK 50,000 (roughly EUR 6,700), plus up to DKK 25,000 in additional accessibility support for logistics and access needs, for a maximum total of DKK 75,000. No co-funding required. No application fee.

item.title: Braunschweig Projects 2027/28: Curatorial Fellowship at HBK Braunschweig
item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline Closed 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months (EUR 19,200 total), plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (the fellow pays EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs), a subsidy of up to EUR 4,000 for exhibition activities and a EUR 2,000 travel budget. No application fee.

item.title: Delfina Foundation x Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation: Open Call for Artists from Portugal and Portuguese-Speaking African Nations (London residency)
item.description: Delfina Foundation, in partnership with the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation (UK Branch) · deadline Closed 04 Oct 2026 · Twelve-week fully funded residency: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials budget of GBP 1,200, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. No application fee.

item.title: Peripheral Acts Edition 2: Leaning Out (UAE balcony residency)
item.description: Peripheral Acts, conceptualised and hosted by Shazia Salam and Priyanka Mehra · deadline Closed 04 Oct 2026 · AED 1,000 artist commission fee plus AED 1,500 production budget per artist. Three artists commissioned. No application fee.

item.title: 2027 LOOP Open Call for Exhibition Proposals (Seoul)
item.description: Alternative Space LOOP · deadline Closed 05 Oct 2026 · Project grant of KRW 1,000,000, plus exhibition space at Alternative Space LOOP, curatorial and operational support, exhibition graphic design and promotion, and use of LOOP's available equipment. 1-2 individuals or teams are selected. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: Ontario Arts Council: Media Artists Creation Projects (October 2026 deadline)
item.description: Ontario Arts Council · deadline Closed 08 Oct 2026 · Emerging: maximum CAD 10,000; Mid-Career and Established: maximum CAD 40,000. No application fee.

item.title: Manitoba Arts Council: Create Grant (October 2026 intake)
item.description: Manitoba Arts Council · deadline Closed 10 Oct 2026 · Emerging: up to CAD 7,500; Mid-career: up to CAD 10,000; Established: up to CAD 15,000. No application fee.

item.title: Eyebeam AGENCY Virtual Residency, Fall 2026 (US-based artists)
item.description: Eyebeam · deadline Closed 11 Oct 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend for each of six selected artists, plus weekly residency programming, mentorship with Eyebeam alumni and visiting professionals, technical consultation, and access to tools and expertise through Eyebeam's network. No application fee (via Submittable).

item.title: Rhizome x Hartwig Art Foundation: Amsterdam City Fellow (two-year digital art research fellowship)
item.description: Rhizome, in partnership with Hartwig Art Foundation · deadline Closed 12 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 per month stipend for a part-time commitment of roughly 2 days per week, over a two-year term (about EUR 28,800 total). Tickets to the Extreme Presence gathering provided. No application fee indicated.

item.title: CNC: Fonds d'aide a la creation immersive (October 2026 session)
item.description: CNC (Centre national du cinema et de l'image animee) · deadline Closed 12 Oct 2026 · Selective aid in four strands: ecriture, preproduction, production and portage. The call page publishes percentage caps (up to 50% of French financing, 80% by derogation); CNC's own published commission results show ecriture grants of EUR 10,000 to 12,000, preproduction up to EUR 60,000 and production up to EUR 80,000. No application fee.

item.title: Institute for Law & AI: Winter Research Fellowship EU Law 2027 (Cambridge, UK)
item.description: Institute for Law & AI (LawAI) · deadline Closed 12 Oct 2026 · GBP 1,000 weekly stipend for the 10-week fellowship (GBP 10,000 total), plus a GBP 7,000 relocation and housing payment. No application fee.

item.title: Fluxus-CPGA Prize at Frieze London 2026
item.description: Fluxus Art Projects, with the Comite Professionnel des Galeries d'Art and Frieze London · deadline Closed 28 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 prize, shared between the artist and their gallery. Participation is free of charge.

item.title: PACT Zollverein: Residencies January to July 2027 (Essen)
item.description: PACT Zollverein · deadline Closed 28 Sep 2026 · Weekly grant allowance of EUR 400 per residency participant (max 4 people), plus studio space (69 to 173 sqm, one barrier-free), local accommodation (max 4 people; barrier-free and family-friendly by arrangement), travel costs for one journey per participant to and from PACT, and technical equipment and professional support by arrangement. No application fee.

item.title: Graner Creative Grants 2027: Residencies for Dance and Live Arts (Barcelona)
item.description: El Graner Fabrica de Creacio, managed by Mercat de les Flors · deadline Closed 29 Sep 2026 · 12 grants totalling EUR 57,000. EUR 6,000 per project for Associated Artist (1 place, EUR 6,000 each for 2027 and 2028), Creation (3 places), Barcelona Crea Research (2) and Barcelona Crea Critical Thinking (1). EUR 3,000 per project for Stage Research (1), International (1), Emerging Artists (2, endowment topped up with EUR 1,700 from Can Gassol) and Practical Methodologies (1). Plus workspace, possible technical residency, artistic support and covered travel to the two annual APLEC gatherings. No application fee.

item.title: culture360 / ASEF: Call for Content, Arts in the Wake of AI
item.description: Asia-Europe Foundation (ASEF), culture360.ASEF.org · deadline Closed 29 Sep 2026 · SGD 250 fee per commissioned article, podcast or video interview. Up to two proposals per application, of which at most one is selected. No application fee.

item.title: Script Pipeline: First Look Project 2026 (screenplay and TV pilot contest)
item.description: Script Pipeline · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 in total prizes across six winners: USD 2,500 to the winner of each of four screenplay genre categories (Action and Sci-Fi, Comedy, Drama, Horror and Thriller) and USD 2,500 to the winner of each of two TV pilot categories (hour and half-hour). All winners also receive long-term circulation to Script Pipeline's industry network of producers, managers, agents and directors, 1-on-1 development assistance from Script Pipeline execs, additional script reviews and consideration of other material, career guidance and mentorship, and invitations to private Symposium events. Entry fee: USD 60 at the regular deadline, rising to USD 65 (late, 15 October) and USD 70 (extended, 30 October).

item.title: Tokyo Biennale 2027: Social Dive open call
item.description: Tokyo Biennale · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · JPY 100,000 honorarium (incl. tax), round-trip travel expenses up to JPY 300,000 (economy, one person), accommodation in Tokyo, project development support up to JPY 200,000 (incl. tax), plus venue coordination, interpretation and translation support and an invitation letter. No application fee.

item.title: BUBBLE Open Call 2026 at Neue Baeckerei (Wiesbaden)
item.description: Neue Baeckerei, Wiesbaden · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 300 artist fee per selected artist, plus up to EUR 100 towards shipping and insurance. No application fee.

item.title: SAM Residencies Open Call: Cycle 4 (2027/2028) at Singapore Art Museum
item.description: Singapore Art Museum · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of SGD 1,500 plus a shared studio or co-working space for all residents. International residents also receive a return economy flight, housing arrangement and visa assistance; Singapore-based residents receive an additional monthly local allowance of SGD 250. No application fee.

item.title: Gurl Grant: USD 2,500 for female and non-binary short film directors
item.description: Gurl Grant (Kat VanCleave) · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · USD 2,500 cash grant toward the production of a narrative short film, awarded twice yearly. No application fee.

item.title: No Drama 2.0: USD 50,000 horror short film initiative (Monkeypaw x Universal x American Cinematheque)
item.description: Monkeypaw Productions, Universal Pictures and American Cinematheque · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · Up to three filmmakers each receive USD 50,000 to fund production of a short film / proof of concept, plus mentorship from Monkeypaw, Universal and American Cinematheque executives, eligibility to screen at Beyond Fest 2027, and first-look consideration from Universal Pictures and Monkeypaw. No application fee.

item.title: MoHA: CATS+ Residency 2026 (Austin)
item.description: The Museum of Human Achievement (MoHA) · deadline Closed 01 Oct 2026 · USD 1,500 honorarium, plus access to MoHA equipment and workspaces.

item.title: Black Public Media: BPM Open Call 2026 (USD 20,000 for nonfiction features)
item.description: Black Public Media · deadline Closed 01 Oct 2026 · USD 20,000 in production funding for up to five projects, each also invited to pitch at PitchBLACK in June 2027, where one project receives an additional USD 150,000 award. Structured as licensing agreements for public media distribution. Free to apply.

item.title: Mozilla Data Collective: Lost in Transcription ASR Challenge
item.description: Mozilla Data Collective (Mozilla Foundation) · deadline Closed 02 Oct 2026 · USD 20,000 total in prizes across three language tracks (per track: USD 4,000 for first place and USD 2,000 for second, plus a bonus award for the lowest average word error rate across all three tracks). No entry fee.

item.title: wpZimmer: Open Call 2027 residencies for collectives (Antwerp)
item.description: wpZimmer · deadline Closed 20 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 (excl. VAT) financial contribution per collective, managed by the collective, plus a five-week residency with two workspaces (a technically equipped studio of approx. 18m x 17m and a medium atelier of approx. 4m x 13m adapted to physical practices) and shared accommodation for up to 6 people. Four collectives selected. No application fee.

item.title: Stigler Center: Journalists in Residence Program Spring 2027 (Chicago Booth)
item.description: Stigler Center, University of Chicago Booth School of Business · deadline Closed 20 Sep 2026 · USD 14,000 stipend to cover living expenses over the 12-week program, plus reimbursement of economy-class airfare to and from Chicago, SEVIS and visa application fees, health insurance through UChicago, and housing guidance. The stipend is subject to up to 14 percent tax withholding for international participants, and you need sufficient funds for roughly the first month before the stipend arrives. No application fee.

item.title: SÍM Residency: Funded Nordic-Baltic Residency January-February 2027 (Reykjavík)
item.description: SÍM Residency (Association of Icelandic Visual Artists) · deadline Closed 01 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,000 stipend for the whole period, EUR 600 travel costs and EUR 500 material costs, plus accommodation (private bedroom, shared kitchen and living spaces) and a private studio. Funded by the Nordic-Baltic Mobility Programme for Culture. Four places.

item.title: Dublin City Council: Visual Arts Exhibition Commission for Ballyfermot Library (curated by IMMA)
item.description: Dublin City Council Creative Hubs programme, delivered by The Ark, curated by IMMA (Irish Museum of Modern Art) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 commission award for research and delivery of commissioned works for the exhibition. Technical support for installation is provided by IMMA, and the artist is supported by Arts Office and Library staff during the research phase. No application fee.
